payload.claim: SA-0314's frontmatter forbids `saffron/scheduler.py`, `saffron/batch.py`, `saffron/task.py` and their tests outright (`.saffron/specs/SA-0314-...md:31-34,42-45`) and limits `touches` to `saffron/spec_citations.py` plus its own test (lines 10-12). The spec's "Problem" section scopes the whole task to "Build the check in `saffron/spec_citations.py` against the landed key, and edit no policy code," with no acceptance criterion or note mentioning multi-parent stacking. The diff nonetheless rewrites `StackBase`/`_resolve_stack_base`/`_deepest_open_parent` here and the matching logic in `saffron/batch.py`, `saffron/task.py`, `tests/test_batch.py`, `tests/test_cli.py`, `tests/test_scheduler.py`, and `tests/test_refusal_count.py` for an unrelated backlog item (b-1572e7, 'deepest open parent' stacking) that SA-0314 never names.
